name: gradient-mcp
description: The Synthesize partner API from the terminal - every endpoint, plus a usage-push ledger, billing drift detection, and alert-to-ticket tracing no other Gradient tool has.

gradient_token.title: GRADIENT_TOKEN
gradient_token.description: The GRADIENT-TOKEN header value, base64("<vendorApiKey>:<partnerApiKey>"). Leave empty when you fill in the vendor and partner API keys; when set, it is used instead of them.

gradient_partner_api_key.title: Gradient partner API key
gradient_partner_api_key.description: Synthesize partner API key, issued with the vendor key. Fill in this and the vendor key, or GRADIENT_TOKEN alone.

gradient_vendor_api_key.title: Gradient vendor API key
gradient_vendor_api_key.description: Synthesize vendor API key (Integrations -> Custom -> Generate API Tokens). Fill in this and the partner key, or GRADIENT_TOKEN alone.

gradient_base_url.title: Gradient MSP API base URL
gradient_base_url.description: Base URL for the Gradient MSP API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

gradient_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
gradient_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

gradient_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
gradient_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

gradient_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
gradient_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Gradient MSP requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

gradient_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
gradient_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
